purpose: Validation-only expansion of the frozen non-graph traffic comparison set with TimesNet and Mamba2.
research_question: Does the already-frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon representation-fusion candidate remain competitive with TimesNet and Mamba2 on METR-LA and PEMS-BAY H12 under the same validation contract?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only fresh-seed baseline expansion. It cannot modify the held-out release, select candidate hyperparameters, or produce test metrics.
claim_boundary: Any result is descriptive until a separately registered held-out comparison. It does not establish graph-aware forecasting or universal speed superiority.

required_before_launch: verify METR-LA and PEMS-BAY fingerprints and exact 18-job expansion
freeze candidate, AutoCon setting, baseline configurations, and budget
preserve a single source snapshot and immutable launch sidecar

selection_contract.freeze_rule: Candidate architecture, AutoCon lambda and all public training settings are frozen; this plan adds baselines only.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share data loader, chronological split, features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch, epoch budget, patience and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.external_baseline_boundary: TimesNet and Mamba2 receive no candidate-only AutoCon or representation-fusion flags.

phases.name: candidate_h12_validation
phases.purpose: Frozen MambaTSv3 AutoCon prediction-connected fusion candidate with fresh seeds.

phases.name: timesnet_mamba2_baselines_h12_validation
phases.purpose: Fresh TimesNet and Mamba2 external baselines without candidate-only settings.

stopping_rules: Do not alter the frozen candidate in response to these baseline values.
Do not run held-out tests from this expansion.
Report any baseline expansion as validation-only and include failed coordinates.
prelaunch_gates: verify METR-LA and PEMS-BAY fingerprints and exact 18-job expansion
freeze candidate, AutoCon setting, baseline configurations, and budget
preserve a single source snapshot and immutable launch sidecar
